$comment: Copy to ~/.config/harness42/local.json (chmod 600) and fill in. It is never committed: the kit is public. `vars` fill the ${NAME} placeholders of profiles/user.json; an MCP server whose `requires` names a var that is missing here is skipped, not half-configured. `settings` merge into ~/.claude/settings.json after the profile, for values that name your own infrastructure (autoMode).
